text: [HISTORY] Ball in midfield, Argentina pressing. [EVENT] pass [INTENSITY] medium [COMMENTARY] Messi finds Di Maria with a crisp pass.

[HISTORY] Midfield battle, ball contested. [EVENT] tackle [INTENSITY] high [COMMENTARY] De Paul slides in to win the ball for Argentina.
[HISTORY] France break, Griezmann through. [EVENT] shot [INTENSITY] high [COMMENTARY] Griezmann's one-on-one saved by the goalkeeper.
[HISTORY] Goal kick for Argentina, long ball forward. [EVENT] pass [INTENSITY] low [COMMENTARY] The clearance finds no one and goes out for a throw-in.
[HISTORY] Pressing high, France win the ball. [EVENT] tackle [INTENSITY] medium [COMMENTARY] Tchouameni stops the Argentine advance.
[HISTORY] Corner kick for France, ball in the box. [EVENT] shot [INTENSITY] medium [COMMENTARY] The header is directed safely wide of the post.
